description: E36 (trained writer, frozen reader) stage-1 rows: whole long documents tokenized with the reader's tokenizer (SmolLM2) and CHUNKED into consecutive rows of exactly 4,610 tokens ([BOS] 4,608 tokens [EOS]); shorter tails are dropped (min_tokens), so every row holds 9 spans of 512 (8 written into memory + 1 continued by the reader) or 17 spans of 256. Books (PG-19 train) and long PDFs (FinePDFs). Spec: docs/4_Research_Notes/e36_frozen_reader_writer_20261018.md.
